profile.jobTitle: Web Developer, Internet Marketing & Social Media Marketing Expert, Speaker, Trainer, Consultant
profile.summary:
Empowering Small & Mid-Sized Businesses Through Strategic Digital Marketing

With over two decades of experience in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing, I specialize in helping small to mid-sized businesses stand out online, drive growth, and maximize their marketing ROI. My mission is to simplify digital marketing, offering customized solutions that align with your unique business goals.

How I Help Businesses Succeed:

✅ Social Media Management – I create and execute targeted social media campaigns that boost engagement and brand visibility.
✅ SEO & Mobile-Friendly Websites – I design effective, websites that capture your audience’s attention and improve search engine rankings.
✅ Compelling Newsletters – Increase customer engagement and sales with newsletters tailored to your audience's needs.
✅ Blog Writing – I craft blog content that attracts new visitors and positions your brand as a leader in your field.
✅ Content Calendars & Marketing Plans – Stay ahead of the competition with strategic digital marketing plans and content calendars.
✅ PPC Campaigns – I manage data-driven pay-per-click advertising to ensure you get the highest return on your ad spend.

As the co-founder of NewWard Development, I’ve been helping businesses navigate the digital space since 1999. Whether on stage, in corporate training sessions, or through one-on-one consulting, my passion lies in simplifying digital marketing for business owners. I bring enthusiasm, energy, and real-world results to every presentation and strategy session.

Digital Marketing as an Art and Science
Social media marketing is more than just a tool—it's the perfect blend of art and science. By leveraging data and creativity, I help businesses showcase their personality online in a way that’s both measurable and meaningful. You’ll know what’s working and when it’s time to pivot, ensuring continuous improvement.

Ready to Take Your Digital Marketing to the Next Level?
Visit www.newward.com to explore how we can collaborate on achieving your digital marketing goals.

Specialties Include:

Social Media Strategy & Implementation
Website Design, Maintenance & Hosting
Email Marketing & Automation
SEO & Content Marketing
PPC Campaign Management
Digital Marketing Consultation

Let’s connect and discuss how I can help elevate your business, enhance your reach, and boost your sales.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Service above Self. 

As with all organizations that are a part of Rotary International - our goal is to empower the world, our community and ourselves through various forms of service. If you have a passion for community involvement, Rotary has the means of helping you achieve your goals. 

We partner with local and International not-for-profits and help them increase the effectiveness in their mission.

ROSNF is a fellowship with a mission to help Rotary club members leverage Social Media to share their story.  Rotary is such a fast, far reaching organization with a HUGE impact on multiple communities around the world.  The best way to communicate the impact Rotary has is through sharing of personal stories and experiences through the social networks.

projects.description: These comprehensive planners are tailored specifically to the needs of each industry. They provide a structured approach to content creation, ensuring that your social media accounts stay fresh, relevant, and informative. With daily prompts, hashtag suggestions, and content ideas, you’ll never be at a loss for what to post.  The content ideas should spark your creativity, and the content prompts on each planner page will help you formulate your posts from your own experiences.
